basic_details.scholarship_name: Ajou University International Graduate Scholarship & Ajou AI Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: Ajou University & South Korean Ministry of Education
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Ajou University Suwon Campus (Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Department of Artificial Intelligence, Department of Computer Engineering, and Department of Software: Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, Autonomous Systems, Cybersecurity, Data Science, and Smart IoT.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 150 full and partial tuition scholarships and lab research assistantships awarded annually across international cohorts
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international merit competition; Pakistani graduate researchers in computing secure ~12 to 18 awards and lab assistantships annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (4 semesters) for Master of Science; up to 3 to 4 years for Doctor of Philosophy, renewed semester-by-semester subject to maintaining minimum 3.5/4.5 GPA
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: KRW 1,000,000 to KRW 1,500,000 / month (~PKR 205,000 - 310,000 / month from lab BK21/BK21 FOUR research funds)

nationality_requirements: International students whose parents are both foreign nationals (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age limit; evaluated on academic achievement and research capabilities.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science / Engineering in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field (16 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 (or 75%+ aggregate) from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan for Master's; research Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum grade equivalent of Grade B+ or 75% marks across academic transcript.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate preparation in algorithms, data structures, machine learning, calculus, linear algebra, and programming (Python, C++).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with expected graduation transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior software development, open-source projects, or published research papers in IEEE/ACM venues significantly strengthen candidacy.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0, TOEFL iBT minimum 80, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from Pakistani university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Korean language proficiency (TOPIK) is not required for English-track STEM graduate degrees.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants should secure informal confirmation / research assistantship endorsement from an Ajou professor prior to admission submission.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full national government scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee and entrance fee waiver at Ajou University covered under the Ajou International Fellowship / Professor Matching Grant.

admission_application_fee.details: Ajou international graduate application fee of KRW 100,000 (~USD 75 / ~PKR 21,000) payable online.

accommodation.details: On-campus international graduate dormitory (Gwanggyo Hall) at Suwon Campus; rent is paid from the monthly lab research stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly research assistantship stipend funded by lab research projects (BK21 FOUR / NRF): KRW 1,000,000 to KRW 1,300,000 per month for Master's; KRW 1,300,000 to KRW 1,500,000 per month for PhD (~PKR 205,000 - 310,000 / month).

airfare.details: International airfare to Incheon/Seoul is arranged by the student; living allowance easily accommodates local savings.

visa_fee.details: Korean D-2 Student Visa application fee (~PKR 15,000) at the Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory Korean National Health Insurance (NHIS ~KRW 70,000 / month for international students) covered from lab research stipend.

food_allowance.details: Covered via the monthly living stipend of KRW 1,000,000 - 1,500,000; affordable campus cafeterias provide balanced meals for KRW 4,500 - 6,500.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Ajou Central Library, engineering laboratories, GPU workstations, and software development platforms.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory funding available through supervisor's BK21 FOUR and National Research Foundation (NRF) grants for presenting research at conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to KRW 2,000,000 for international conference attendance

travel_transit_allowance.details: Suwon public transport discounts and direct subway connection via Gwanggyo Jungang Station (Shinbundang Line, 30 mins to Gangnam, Seoul).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single premier South Korean technological university: Ajou University.
participating_institutions: Ajou University (Suwon Campus, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 500 globally in QS World University Rankings, top 15 in South Korea, and renowned for AI, software engineering, and industry partnerships with Samsung Electronics (headquartered in Suwon).
available_majors: Data Science and Big Data Analytics
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 years (4 semesters) for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree with strong academic record (CGPA >= 3.3/4.0), professor recommendation/endorsement, study plan (2 pages), two recommendation letters, and certified English proficiency.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Ajou AI and Computer Engineering laboratories have heavy Samsung-funded R&D projects; securing supervisor endorsement between October and November or April and May is the primary determinant of admission and funding.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Browse the Ajou Department of AI and Computer Engineering faculty directory (ai.ajou.ac.kr), find matching professors in AI/computing, and email a tailored research proposal and CV before submitting on the admission portal.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Uwayapply Online Application System & Ajou Graduate School Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Contact prospective supervisor directly via email, obtain research endorsement, register on Uwayapply during the application window, submit online application, and mail physical attested documents to Ajou Graduate School.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore faculty research profiles on Ajou AI portal (https://ai.ajou.ac.kr/) and email prospective supervisors.
Step 2: Obtain written endorsement / research assistantship commitment from the prospective supervisor.
Step 3: Register and apply online on the Uwayapply portal (https://www.uwayapply.com/) during the open call (October - November for Spring / April - May for Fall).
Step 4: Pay the application fee of KRW 100,000 online.
Step 5: Send physical attested transcripts, degrees, recommendation letters, and bank statement to Ajou Graduate School in Suwon.
Step 6: Attend faculty technical interview via Zoom if required.
Step 7: Receive official Certificate of Admission (CoA), and apply for Korean D-2 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Supervisor Track: Admission and tuition waiver are processed jointly with supervisor's research stipend endorsement.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted on institutional letterhead signed by former academic professors or research supervisors.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal statement and study plan outlining academic background, technical capabilities, and postgraduate research vision.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 2 to 3-page research proposal detailing background, problem statement, research methodology, and expected timeline.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV highlighting technical projects, publications, programming proficiencies, and awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 20 to 30-minute technical interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and faculty panel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.0), TOEFL iBT (min 80), or institutional English MOI letter accepted; GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts attested by HEC and MOFA Pakistan, followed by Apostille or Consular Legalization at the Korean Embassy in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Korean translation required for all official documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Uwayapply followed by physical document dispatch to Ajou Suwon.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for 16-year Bachelor's (for MSc) or 18-year Master's (for PhD) with minimum CGPA 3.3/4.0.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested copies from HEC and MOFA Pakistan, with Korean Embassy consular legalization.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 2 to 3-page structured proposal outlining problem statement, methodology, and timeline.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be aligned with Ajou supervisor's funded research area.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letter or email confirmation from an eligible Ajou professor agreeing to supervise and fund.
Confidential academic evaluations from previous professors.
IELTS Academic (min 6.0), TOEFL iBT (min 80), or institutional English MOI letter.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: MOI letter signed by university registrar.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Bank statement showing minimum USD 20,000 (often waived or reduced with professor financial affidavit).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Bank certificate issued in English under applicant's or parents' name.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of all passport pages valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.application_open_date: October 1 (for Spring intake) / April 1 (for Fall intake)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions operate on two semester intakes: Spring (March commencement) and Fall (September commencement). Applying 3-4 months in advance is recommended.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Quality of research proposal, technical project portfolio, and supervisor match)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of purpose and postgraduate research vision)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Interview performance factored directly into supervisor endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Ajou Graduate School Admissions Committee and Department of AI Postgraduate Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: supervisor nomination followed by faculty board academic review.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,000 to 1,500 international graduate applicants across Ajou
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~100 to 150 graduate scholarships and assistantships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~10% to 15% among candidates with supervisor consent
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.45+ / 4.00 from top Pakistani engineering institutions (NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET, NED)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of accredited computing and engineering faculties with solid programming foundations and practical capstone projects.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani computer science, software engineering, and electronic engineering faculties.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, China, Vietnam, Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Iran, Russia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of educational agents claiming to provide 'guaranteed Ajou admissions or scholarship awards'.
Applications are handled exclusively via the official Uwayapply portal and Ajou Graduate School (https://grad-e.ajou.ac.kr/).
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Ajou application fee is KRW 100,000 paid directly on the Uway portal; never transfer funds to personal bank accounts.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Ajou University does not work with third-party agents for research degree admissions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Initial pocket money before first stipend transfer: ~KRW 500,000 (~PKR 102,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You must know Korean to study at Ajou. Reality: Ajou AI and Computer Engineering graduate programs are conducted 100% in English.
Myth: Suwon is too far from Seoul. Reality: Suwon is part of the Seoul Capital Area, accessible in just 30 minutes by express subway.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial websites state TOPIK is mandatory; TOPIK is NOT mandatory for English-track STEM graduate degrees at Ajou.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum GPA 3.50 / 4.50 each semester to renew the tuition fee waiver.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research attendance in the faculty research lab at Suwon Campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual progress reports evaluated by the Faculty Supervisory Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work permitted up to legal Korean immigration limits with university endorsement; research assistants fulfill lab obligations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No return obligation; graduates are eligible for Korean post-study D-10 job seeker visas or point-based residence visas (F-2-7).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Publication milestone obligation: must publish at least 1-2 papers in SCIE-indexed journals prior to thesis defense.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding cancelled if the candidate fails GPA maintenance or withdraws without approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Non-transferable to other universities; tied specifically to Ajou University.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from both current and prospective supervisors and the Graduate School Board.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for standard duration (2 years for Master's; 3-4 years for PhD).
